description.content: Wraps a cell and measures its rendered content. Measurements are stored in a per-cell cache. Cached-content is not be re-measured.
The child must be a DOM element (e.g. <div>) or a component that passes its ref along to one; otherwise use a function child and pass registerChild as the ref of the element to be measured.
Cache to be shared between CellMeasurer and its parent Grid. Typically an instance of CellMeasurerCache.
Either a React element as a child (eg <div />) or a function (eg. ({ measure, registerChild }) => <div ref={registerChild} />).

CellMeasurer attaches a ref to the child element to find the DOM element to measure (the child's own ref, if any, still receives the element). So the child must be a DOM element (e.g. <div>) or a component that passes its ref along to one: in React 19, a function component can pass its ref prop to a DOM element; in React 18, function components must use forwardRef for this.

The function receives a measure callback (to re-measure the cell, e.g. after an image has loaded) and a registerChild callback (to specify the DOM element to be measured; can be used as a ref). Use registerChild if the child doesn't pass its ref along to a DOM element, or to measure an element nested within the child.
Children that can't be measured (e.g. text, an array or a fragment, without registerChild) are rendered as-is, and a warning is logged in development mode.
